verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy-posture question for a fintech banking platform, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented retention policy, retention settings, or account- or data-deletion capability. Resource-level CRUD deletes (categories, customers, webhook endpoints) and revoking MCP/API access are adjacent controls, not retention or deletion control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
